verdict.rationale: Fenwick's employment practice page documents that the firm regularly advises employers on employment and independent contractor agreements, and separately lists protecting trade secrets and confidential business information. Offer letters and invention-assignment agreements are not named. Missing for 10: explicit offer-letter drafting, explicit invention-assignment/confidentiality agreement preparation, any detail or independent corroboration of the hiring-paperwork workflow.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm prepares hiring paperwork — offer letters, employment agreements, and invention-assignment/confidentiality agreements — as part of a documented employment practice
